heading: Charming cabins
in South Iceland.
hero.body: Two self-catering homes in South Iceland: a secluded cabin for four right on the lake near Kirkjubæjarklaustur, and a six-bedroom family house with a hot tub in Hveragerði.

cabinsIntro.body: Two cozy and charming places to stay in South Iceland, near some of the region's most popular natural wonders.

reviews.heading: Don't just take our word for it!
reviews.body: We have great reviews from our past guests. The reviews often mention the serenity and amazing nature around the cabins.

location.heading: Our cabin is located a short distance from the town Kirkjubæjarklaustur
body: The cabin is located on the South Coast, around a 3-hour drive from Reykjavík. The location is the perfect base for exploring the South Coast with plenty of attraction and natural wonders around.
Below you can see the distance between the cabin and some of the most popular sites to visit while staying at our cabin.

attractions.name: Seljalandsfoss
attractions.body: The Seljalandsfoss waterfall drops 60 m (197 ft) and is part of the Seljalands River that has its origin in the volcano glacier Eyjafjallajökull. One of the most remarkable things about this waterfall is that you can walk behind the fall into a small cave.

attractions.name: Skógafoss
attractions.body: Skógafoss is one of the biggest waterfalls in Iceland, the width of the waterfall is 25 metres (82 feet) and the drop of it is 60 m (200 ft). Due to the amount of spray the waterfall consistently produces, a single or double rainbow is normally visible on sunny days.

attractions.name: Fjaðrárgljúfur
attractions.body: A stunning canyon, 2 km long and up to 100 m deep. Easily accessible from the Ring Road.

attractions.name: Systrafoss
attractions.body: A beautiful waterfall, 60-80 meters tall. It's has a lot of folklore and history around it and a must stop when in South Iceland.

attractions.name: Kirkjugólf
attractions.body: Kirkjugólf, or 'the church floor,' is an 80 square meter expanse of columnar basalt stone slabs that slowly eroded when the sea covered the area.

attractions.name: Svartifoss
attractions.body: Svartifoss is a stunning waterfall, 20 metres tall, and black columnar basalt formations beautifully frame the waterfall and give it its name, Black Fall.

attractions.name: Jökulsárlón
attractions.body: Jökulsárlón is Iceland's most famous glacier lagoon and a popular stop for those traveling along the South Coast or around the Ring Road of the country.

tours.heading: Explore South Iceland with our trusted partners

items.body: Are you fascinated with lava, volcanoes, and geology? Would you like to see red-hot lava up close in a safe environment? See molten lava flow, hear it sizzle and feel its heat — just along the coast from the cabins.
A full day in the highland valley of Þórsmörk with Midgard, crossing glacial rivers by super jeep. Roads and route are chosen on the day to suit the conditions.
Two and a half hours on a buggy with Southcoast Adventure, setting out from their base on Road 249 and taking in a little of everything the south has to offer. Two people per booking.
